betterquesting:10.desc:8:
Same idea as the Item IO board, but for §6fluids§f. The §6Liquid IO Circuit Board§f goes into Fueling Stations, Rolling Machines, Centrifuges, Chemical Reactors, Electrolysers, and anything with a fluid tank.

Two recipes: §6vanilla crafting§f (redstone, quartz, lapis lazuli, wood slab, iron plate) and §6Precision Assembler§f (200 ticks, 10 RF/t) using redstone, lapis, and steel plate. Multiblock machines with multiple fluid hatches may need 2-4 boards each.

The Liquid IO board is also a component in the AE2 1k ME Fluid Storage Component, so you'll need it for your storage network too.

§ePS:§f Lapis lazuli is the bottleneck ingredient. A Lapis Farm with silk touch pays for itself in no time at this stage.
